title: Multi-SFT: Permissively-Licensed Multilingual Instruction-Following
abstract: arXiv:2610.22086v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Supervised fine-tuning datasets remain overwhelmingly English-centric and commercially restricted, as their content is frequently generated by proprietary models whose terms of service forbid training competing systems. We introduce Multi-SFT, a commercially permissive collection of 502,818 instruction-response pairs across five European languages, built via translation and regeneration pipelines for tasks where translation is insufficient. Human evaluation yields inter-annotator agreement of at least 0.87 across all datasets and languages. Fine-tuning nine models from three different families (EuroLLM, OLMo 2, Qwen3; 1B-32B) and evaluating them on 13 benchmarks shows that Multi-SFT alone is competitive with larger augmented mixes and official instruction-tuned releases, with decisive advantages on safety tasks.

translated_title: Multi-SFT：宽松许可的多语言指令遵循数据集
translated_abstract: 监督微调数据集目前仍以英语为中心且在商业使用上受限，因为其内容通常由专有模型生成，而这些模型的服务条款禁止将其用于训练竞争系统。我们提出了 Multi-SFT，这是一个商业上可宽松使用的数据集，包含覆盖五种欧洲语言的 502,818 个指令-响应对。该数据集通过翻译流水线构建，对于翻译不足以覆盖的任务则采用再生成流水线。人工评估显示，在所有数据集和语言上，标注者间一致性至少达到 0.87。我们对来自三个不同模型家族（EuroLLM、OLMo 2、Qwen3；参数量 1B-32B）的九个模型进行了微调，并在 13 个基准上进行评估。结果表明，仅使用 Multi-SFT 进行微调即可与更大的增强混合数据集以及官方指令微调版本相媲美，且在安全任务上具有决定性优势。
tldr: Multi-SFT 是一个包含 50 万余条跨五种欧洲语言、商业可宽松使用的指令微调数据集，仅用它微调的模型即可媲美更大规模混合数据集和官方指令微调版本，并在安全任务上具有显著优势。
